name: Elven Gem
summary: Elven Gems are calcified stones lying on the sea floor near Faldir’s Cove. Doctor Draxlegauge’s goggles help you find them for Captain O’Breen’s search for lost treasure.

sections.title: Stones Below
sections.body: The sea has covered the treasure for so long that its gems have hardened inside thick stone. Near Faldir’s Cove, Doctor Draxlegauge lends you his Goggles of Gem Hunting to find them. He asks you to gather ten Elven Gems for Captain O’Breen, then return the goggles.

faq.q: Where do Elven Gems come from?
faq.answer: Elven Gems lie on the sea floor near Faldir’s Cove, sealed in calcified stone.
The treasure has rested on the sea floor so long that the gems have calcified into thick stone.
Doctor Draxlegauge asks you to collect ten Elven Gems for Captain O’Breen’s search for lost treasure.

faq.q: How do you find the gems?
faq.answer: Doctor Draxlegauge lends you the Goggles of Gem Hunting, which help you locate the calcified gems.
Doctor Draxlegauge is a gnome in Faldir’s Cove who lends you his gem-hunting goggles. He prefers to keep to safe, dry land.
